Metadata ID: AAS_3042_Transects_2010-11 
Title: Windmill Islands vegetation transects, surveyed 2010/11 (8 years)

This record contains data associated with the Windmill Islands eight year vegetation survey conducted in 2010/11, under AAS_3042. Baseline survey described in Metadata ID: ASAC_1313_Transects_2002-03, five and 10 year surveys described in ASAC_1313_Transects_2007-08 and AAS_4046_Transects_2012-13, respectively. 

Descriptions of data associated with this record are provided below under the following headings: 
1. LOCATION (GPS) DATA (and MAPS)
2. QUADRAT PHOTOS
3. NOTEBOOK SCANS
4. MICROSCOPY SCORE SHEETS
5. FINESCALE SPECIES ABUNDANCE (MICROSCOPY)
6. BROADSCALE PERCENT COVER (IMAGE ANALYSIS) 
7. ENVIRONMENTAL VARIABLES (e.g. MOISTURE, TEMPERATURE)
8. PROCESSED/COMPILED/WORKED
